title: Every sample, accumulated
description: Exact empirical cumulative steps compare distributions, inclusive threshold shares and empirical percentiles without bins.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-owned { id, label, tone?, samples } series. Samples contain { id, value }; IDs must be unique and nonempty within their series. Finite signed values are sorted without mutating input; equal values form one inclusive cumulative jump. Null and nonfinite values are omitted and counted. Each series normalizes by its own finite sample count. No smoothing, density estimation or weighting is applied.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Optional finite horizontal threshold. Keys report the exact share of measured samples at or below it; the numeric domain includes it, including thresholds outside the sampled range.

props.name: percentiles
props.description: Distinct empirical inverse-CDF probabilities in (0, 1], defaulting to [0.5, 0.9]. Each reading is the smallest observed value whose cumulative share reaches the requested probability; there is no interpolation. An empty list hides percentile guides and readings.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned heading identifying the measured quantity or analytical question.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional reporting period, units or statistical context supplied by the application.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats absolute readings and tooltip values; axis ticks use compact numbers. Defaults to en-US with up to two decimals.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and keys scroll inside the frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
